posts.title: Summary
posts.text: Closing summary This concludes our live coverage of the second Trump administration for the day. Here are the latest developments: House Republicans blocked an effort to impeach Pete Hegseth, rejecting allegations that the defense secretary had repeatedly violated the constitution through his handling of the Iran war…

Reporters Without Borders has called on the incoming Democratic Congress to impeach Brendan Carr, the Federal Communications Commission chair. The press freedom group said Carr’s tenure as chair of the FCC has “has been defined by his campaign to intimidate and punish media organizations disfavored by the president,”…

With world leaders set to begin formal talks at the United Nations climate change conference tomorrow, the United States is skipping the climate summit for the second year in a row. California’s outgoing governor Gavin Newsom will lead a delegation to Cop31, which is being held in Turkey this year. In a social media…

Bessent will travel to China next week for Donald Trump’s third meeting this year with Chinese president Xi Jinping, which is expected to be help on…

Congresswoman Melanie Stansbury said she and other members of Congress were blocked from entering the Capitol to vote on a motion to block Pete Hegseth’s impeachment “due a traffic incident and a police escort of a bus during the vote.” “When she reached the chamber the vote had just gaveled out,” the congresswoman…

Congresswoman Doris Matsui has won her bid for re-election to represent California’s 7th district. Matsui, who’s represented Sacramento since 2005 when she was elected to fill her late husband’s seat, faced a challenge from younger Democrat Mai Vang.

Vote counting is still ongoing in Mississippi, where Democrat Scott Colom is trying to edge out incumbent Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith. With 97% of votes counted, this evening the Associated Press updated its tally to show Colom leading by 2,678 votes. The race is nail-bitingly close, as you’ll recall earlier today we…

After Democrats lost a House vote to advance impeachment proceedings against Pete Hegseth today by just 7 votes, members of the party have voiced frustration that not all its representatives attended the vote. As CNN’s Jake Tapper notes, Julia Brownley of California, Lou Correa of California, Chris van Hollen of…

Mike Johnson, the outgoing Republican speaker of the House, praised Jim Jordan, who Republicans elected today to lead their House contingent in January. “Jim and I go back a long ways,” Johnson said in remarks to reporters today, adding that Jordan “was a mentor of mine when I first came to Congress.”
